published.source: rotation audit 19b: end-of-fight Shadow Word: Death (2026-10-15)

summary: A Holy damage priest: 31 Discipline (Power in Light, Twin Disciplines, Holy Precision, Power Infusion) and 17 Holy (Divine Fury, Searing Light) casting Smite and Holy Fire. Shipped as its own spec on its own hit-free gear, 17% behind Shadow at 180 s because Smite is a mana-hungry filler.
rotation: Pre-pull: Smite at -2 s that lands at the pull, the on-use trinket at -0.1 s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 40% mana; Power Infusion on cooldown; racials and trinkets on cooldown
Inner Focus right before Holy Fire
Holy Fire whenever its DoT is down (keeps Power in Light up)
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is down (9+ s left)
Devouring Plague whenever it is down (12+ s left) and mana is at least 40%
Shadow Word: Death when a Smite would not land before the fight ends
Rank 8 Smite while mana lasts the fight at 35 mana a second
consumes: Elixir of Holy Power (Elixir of Greater Firepower)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Smite VIII's base damage ×1.09, halfway to rank 4's ratio to Era (the 31+ ranks look partly un-retuned); the client has ×1.00
Forever's downrank penalty modeled (5% of the coefficient per level past 17 below the caster), so the fallback Smite is rank 7, which keeps its full coefficient
Penance and Mind Blast dropped by the search (Penance: 385 mana for three 92-damage bolts); Shadow Word: Death only at the end of the fight
Synthetic gear, Vestments of Conviction 2-piece only (4/5-piece +4.7)
Kreeg's Stout Beatdown left out as a Dire Maul item; Elixir of Sages left out by the one-crit-elixir ruling (+6.4)
Dark Sacrifice gives 1600 + Spirit mana (tooltip adds Spirit; client data says 1600)
notes: mksettings request plus ConsumesSmite from presets.ts: defaultPotion MajorManaPotion, firePowerBuff ElixirOfGreaterFirepower, manaRegenElixir GreaterMagebloodElixir, spiritElixir ElixirOfGreaterSpirit. Gear level60_phase1_smite, apl level60_smite.
